title: CervoRules policy vocabulary v1
description: Closed schema for policy-vocabulary.yaml/json files consumed by cervorules-vocabgen.

capabilities.description: Caller-owned capability names that requests can ask for.

services.description: Caller-owned service names that policies can route to.

providers.description: Caller-owned provider names that policies can use as primary or fallback providers.

description.description: Human-readable purpose for agents and reviewers.

go_name.description: Optional exported Go identifier suffix used by code generation.
